value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "To examine the way that feminist approaches to relational work in RPPs su pport practitioner understandings of the RPPs in which they participate, we looked across two school-based design partnership projects in the Western region of the United States."
